name: Montserrat

flag.description: A Blue Ensign with the coat of arms in the fly: a woman in a green dress holding a golden harp and embracing a dark cross.
flag.symbolism: The woman is Erin, the personification of Ireland, honoring the Irish settlers who came to the island in the 17th century.

hook: Montserrat's badge is a woman in green hugging a cross and holding a harp: Ireland's Erin, on the "Emerald Isle of the Caribbean".
trivia: St Patrick's Day is a public holiday on Montserrat, which is nicknamed the "Emerald Isle of the Caribbean".
Eruptions of the Soufrière Hills volcano from 1995 buried the capital, Plymouth, which has been abandoned ever since.
